import copy,json; from work import evaluate
with open('policy.json') as f: p=json.load(f)
with open('requests.json') as f: rs=json.load(f)
with open('report.json') as f: report=json.load(f)
assert report == [evaluate(r,p) for r in rs]
r={'from':'ready','to':'running','role':'wrong','retry':True,'attempts':False}; rb=copy.deepcopy(r); pb=copy.deepcopy(p)
assert evaluate(r,p)=={'ok':False,'value':None,'reason':'permission'}
assert r==rb and p==pb
assert evaluate({'from':'x','to':'y'},p)=={'ok':False,'value':None,'reason':'blocked'}
assert evaluate({'from':'failed','to':'ready','retry':True,'attempts':False},p)['reason']=='retry_limit'
assert evaluate({'from':'failed','to':'ready','retry':True,'attempts':-1},p)['reason']=='retry_limit'
assert evaluate({'from':'failed','to':'ready','retry':True,'attempts':2},p)['reason']=='retry_limit'
assert evaluate({'from':'failed','to':'ready','retry':True,'attempts':1},p)=={'ok':True,'value':'ready','reason':'ok'}
print('all checks passed')
